activity_summary: Upstairs Field used thou. The second volume was heavy as a hearthstone and opened at the second Richard. You read four columns standing: a king, his uncles, a cousin banished, a landing, and a crown handed across. Jacqueline put a stool behind your knees. Field said it is lent, Lent in Lent, and he will see the gap every morning until it is home. You named no day. She set a stack of quires where you stood, and that ended the visit. You took the book in both arms.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read four columns on your feet, named no return day, and carried the book.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Spoke thou, lent the volume, and kept the gap as his morning fact.

entities.name: Jacqueline Field
entities.context: Set the stool, and then set the quires in the place where you stood.

entities.name: Holinshed, second volume
entities.context: Mentioned in Heavy as a hearthstone

facets.activity: Read four columns and carried the book

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: Heavy as a hearthstone, and lent.

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: Lent in Lent, and I'll see the gap on that shelf every morning till it's home.

quotes.speaker: jacqueline_field
quotes.text: These quires go where your feet are.
